title: Paul Prescott's Charge
author: Alger, Horatio, Jr.
description: "Paul Prescott's Charge" by Horatio Alger, Jr.
longDescription: is a novel aimed at young readers, likely written in the late 19th century. The book follows the story of a young boy named Paul Prescott, whose life takes a tragic turn upon the death of his father.

authorInfo.bio: Alger, Horatio, Jr. (1832–1899) is the author of Paul Prescott's Charge. This historical edition is part of the author’s surviving literary work. Explore the linked biographical record for their life and bibliography.
